interlock.description: Optional monitored interlock input; hidden from the Phase 1 interface unless enabled experimentally.

remoteStop.description: Optional remote-stop input; hidden from the Phase 1 interface unless enabled experimentally.

sensors.description: Optional sensor and module fields; hidden from the Phase 1 interface unless enabled experimentally.

fields.description: Requests activation or deactivation of the LSN emission-control function.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Validate the request, evaluate all blocking conditions, and activate the control output only when permitted.
fields.expectedReportedResponse: Requested state is acknowledged; reported and hardware-control states remain independently readable.
fields.notes: This is an emission-control request, not proof of optical emission.

fields.description: Momentary request to clear a resettable fault when its blocking condition is no longer present.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Attempt to clear resettable faults without bypassing active blocking conditions.
fields.expectedReportedResponse: Faulted and FaultCode update to the resulting state.
fields.notes: No behavior is assigned for non-resettable faults.

fields.description: Reports whether LSN is initialized and ready to evaluate control requests.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Report whether the LSN state machine is initialized and able to evaluate control requests.
fields.notes: Ready does not mean emission control is active.

fields.description: Reports the current state of the LSN emission-control hardware output.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Report the current state of the LSN emission-control hardware output.
fields.notes: Never infer optical emission from this value.

fields.expectedReportedResponse: Boolean interlock state; an open condition blocks control.
fields.notes: Logical state remains independent of GPIO assignment.

fields.expectedReportedResponse: Boolean remote-stop state; an open condition blocks control.
fields.notes: Applicable when remote-stop hardware is present.

fields.description: Reports whether LSN currently has an active fault.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Report whether an active fault is present.
fields.expectedReportedResponse: Boolean fault state accompanied by FaultCode.

fields.description: Reports the active profile-defined fault code.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Report the profile-defined active fault code.

fields.description: Reports whether the lifetime runtime counter is currently accumulating time.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Report NotCounting, Counting, Fault, or Unknown according to runtime accumulation.
fields.notes: Final numeric enum values remain TBD.

fields.description: Accumulated lifetime emission-control active time in milliseconds.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Persistently accumulate time only while the emission-control output is active.
fields.notes: No normal remote reset command is permitted.

fields.description: Accumulated number of successful inactive-to-active emission-control transitions.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Persistently increment once per successful inactive-to-active control transition.

fields.description: Reports whether a network client currently owns control of LSN.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Report whether a network client currently owns control.
fields.notes: Ownership policy remains to be finalized.

fields.description: Reports the implemented LSN communications-interface version.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Expose the implemented logical protocol version.
fields.expectedReportedResponse: Version string comparable with the active Device Profile.

fields.description: Reports the currently running LSN application firmware version.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Expose the running application firmware version.

fields.description: Canonical logical device-identity field. Final representation and mapping remain TBD pending the firmware engineer's CIP Identity Object implementation.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Expose a stable unique device identity.

fields.description: Reports the LSN hardware revision when available.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Expose the hardware revision when available.

fields.description: Reports the reason for the most recent transition from active to inactive emission control.
fields.expectedFirmwareBehavior: Record the reason for the latest active-to-inactive transition.
fields.notes: Final numeric enum values remain TBD.
